conditions.baseline: Same binary with -LegacySceneryActors -LegacyPreviewCollision; source feature bookkeeping remains in both variants.
workloads: Real campus: 29 editable buildings, 1359 road features, 407 context features, no room interiors.
Generated ten-floor interior: 225 rooms; no roads/context features.

interpretation: Resident bytes are working set; private committed bytes are a separate metric and must not be added.
Positive paired savings mean legacy minus optimized; each process phase is summarized by its median, then paired differences summarized across three repeats.
Short steady-state windows on one machine do not establish peaks, leaks or an app-wide average.
Timing is a frame-capped sanity check including settle/load hitches, not an uncapped rendering throughput benchmark.
Empty baseline includes engine/driver caches; both absolute and baseline-adjusted differences are retained.
Prototype frame summaries use engine Tick DeltaTime, which can be clamped; max_ms is not a wall-clock hitch measurement. Final verification uses a monotonic tick interval instead.
decision: Scenery batching rejected from final implementation: the three campus pairs did not show a RAM saving. Preview-only collision removal retained for final verification.
